name: Dio (Pantheon)
creator: sauronkaiser
description:
Base champions: Pantheon 

Skin: Default

Author: Sauronkaiser

Description: Dio from JJBA Stardust crusaders.

Features:

-New model and textures.

-New full set of animations.

-New sounds.

-New particles

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-New voiceover (for both mods)

-Roadroller driving licence not included.



Sources:

-Dio's and Stand model extracted from JJBA Diamond records.

-Voices extracted from JJBA Stardust crusaders.

-Roadroller model made by DopamineWarlock. You can find his works in his sketchfab: https://sketchfab.com/DopamineWarlock

-All animations and effects made by me.

Legacy Changelog:

-08/01/2023: First official release

-03/05/2023: Fixed after a League patch made it crash the game, some particles fixes.

-29/10/2023: Fixed voiceover for all languages, added new particles.

-21/06/2024: Fixed voiceover and made global for all languages, mod fixed for low quality settings and several particle problems.
